# Graph Box Role

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:GraphBoxRole`](gmeow-GraphBoxRole.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/GraphBoxRole>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A documentation and validation role describing which graph layer a term, shape, module, or graph artifact primarily serves: assertional data (ABox), terminology/schema (TBox), role/property behavior (RBox), contextual statement metadata (CBox), or runtime/package/profile configuration (ConfigBox). Roles are descriptive annotations, may be multi-valued, and never partition the ontology into exactly one box per resource.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:GraphBoxRole`](gmeow-GraphBoxRole.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when a term, shape, generated report, or documentation surface needs to say whether it is about asserted data, schema/logic, role/property behavior, statement context, or operational configuration/profile metadata.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using box roles as logical class membership, named-graph routing, or an exactly-one partition; a construct can legitimately serve more than one box.

### How to use

- Annotate the subject with one or more [`gmeow:graphBoxRole`](../properties/gmeow-graphBoxRole.md) values. Tooling may render the roles in describe output, generated docs, validation reports, and GTS/package summaries, but the annotations do not alter OWL entailments.

- [`gmeow:confidence`](../properties/gmeow-confidence.md) [`gmeow:graphBoxRole`](../properties/gmeow-graphBoxRole.md) [`gmeow:boxCBox`](../individuals/gmeow-boxCBox.md).
